svg.text: Node.js + Express | MongoDB / Mongoose | Multer + Cloudinary
Based on the current source. Arrows describe the implemented wiring and intended registration flow.
Connect to MongoDB; exit on failure
Multer writes files; Cloudinary reads these paths.
On upload failure: delete local file
On success: local file is retained
HTTP JSON response returned to caller
Wrap async controller; rejection calls next(err)
ApiError carries status, message, errors and stack
No custom Express error middleware is registered
No login / refresh routes; JWT signing is incomplete
Video metadata, views, owner and timestamps
No video router or controller; stray I identifier
Pagination package imported; plugin not applied
Registration stops at the duplicate check: User.findOne(...) has no await, so its Query object is always truthy.
Other mismatches: Cloud_name config key; ApiResponse argument order; JWT secret / expiry arguments.
These boxes map the current code structure; the downstream registration path requires those fixes to run successfully.
Scope: all 11 src JavaScript files, package.json and public/temp. The gray video model has no connected endpoint.
